issues.title: No trial table in the V2 drop: trial location and year are unknown
issues.root_cause: the drop ships the trial-germplasm bridge but no trial master; its TRIAL_GUIDs do not match the deprecated trial table (0 of 72 match), so location and year cannot be joined
issues.fix: season year derived from the SOWING date; location left empty, never guessed
issues.impact: G x E (location / year effects) cannot be assessed; candidate colours do not depend on it
issues.sme_question: Can you share the V2 trial master (location, year, design)?

issues.title: No breeder decision recorded yet
issues.root_cause: BREEDER_DECISION and BREEDER_COMMENT are empty for 150 of 150 candidates; the system suggestion is {'RED': 65, 'AMBER': 53, 'GREEN': 32}
issues.fix: the Breeder's Desk records it: pass / no pass per candidate and colour overrides with a reason, append-only
issues.impact: this is the gap the product closes: suggestion -> decision with an audit trail

issues.title: Lines genotyped but not yet in any trial
issues.root_cause: present in pedigree and genomics, absent from the trial-germplasm bridge
issues.fix: kept AMBER with the official reason 'No field data yet (genotyped only)'
issues.impact: no performance claim is made for them

issues.title: Commercial checks are reference entries, not candidates
issues.root_cause: the bridge marks them ENTRY_ROLE_LID = CHECK; they are in the pedigree but not in the candidate recommendations
issues.fix: used only as the yield reference ('yield vs checks'); never triaged
issues.impact: yield vs checks is recomputed per trial against the mean of both checks

issues.title: Field operations done late
issues.root_cause: actual date after the planned date
issues.fix: reported; delays do not exclude a trial in the official rule
